bind_addr.description: Socket address the HTTP server binds to (e.g. '0.0.0.0:8443').

auth_token.description: Bearer token clients must present on REST endpoints and WS upgrades.

static_dir.description: Path to ui-web's `dist/` directory (optional). Enables SPA serving with fallback to index.html.

cors_origins.description: Allowed CORS origins. If empty, no CORS middleware is installed.

tick_interval_secs.description: How often the WebSocket sends a UiEvent::Tick keepalive.

ingest.description: Optional HTTP-push log ingest receiver (POST /api/ingest/logs). Migrated from legacy api.http_push.

enabled.description: Mount the /api/ingest/logs route. When false the route returns 404.

token.description: Bearer token for the ingest endpoint. Falls back to auth_token when omitted.

parser.description: Parser applied to each ingested line.

rate_limit_per_sec.description: Maximum accepted requests per second (per-process sliding window).

max_request_size_mb.description: Maximum request body size in megabytes.
